summary: Full backend + frontend E2E of the structural evolution (hierarchical categories, cost_price, product images, order CMV snapshots, analytics dashboard). Added a dedicated pytest suite (30 new tests) and re-ran the full 50-test regression suite. Manually verified: hierarchical categories admin UI (create main + sub, tree, product count), product modal with cost + main/subcategory + margin display (R$60,00 · 60.00%), image URL add + upload PNG (multipart) + set primary + delete inside edit modal, dashboard with all KPIs, rankings and all period filters (today/7d/30d/this_month/last_month/custom), cost warning shown, storefront regression intact (home + /produtos catalog + product page with images, cost_price never leaked to public HTML).

issues: Uses browser native <input type='date'> for custom-start/custom-end (locale-dependent format, e.g. 12/31/2030 on en-US). Consider using a shadcn/Calendar component for consistency with the rest of admin UI.

action_items: REGRESSION FIX APPLIED by testing agent: /app/backend/app/services/coupon_service.py line 21 — `subtotal * coupon.value / 100` was crashing with `TypeError: unsupported operand type(s) for *: 'float' and 'decimal.Decimal'` after the Decimal migration (coupon.value is Numeric/Decimal, subtotal is float). Fix: cast to float(coupon.value). Please review + keep. Without this, ANY checkout with a percent-coupon (BRASIL10 / MINIS20) returned 500.
Optional: replace native date inputs in Dashboard (custom-start/custom-end) with the existing shadcn Calendar component for consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: coupon_service.resolve_coupon mixed Decimal and float arithmetic → 500 on coupon checkout. Fixed by testing agent.

analytics_service.compute(): 'net_revenue' is computed as `revenue_gross - discounts + shipping_charged`. The naming may confuse users — it's really 'revenue after discount + shipping charged'. Consider renaming or adding a tooltip; not a functional bug.

order_service creates items list on the ORM Order.items JSON column but relies on to_dict to expose. The frozen CMV snapshots (unit_cost_snapshot, line_cogs, line_gross_profit, has_cost) are correctly stored inside the JSON items — customers see them on GET /api/orders too. If the spec requires hiding CMV even from customer order responses (leakage), the storefront /api/orders returns the full items JSON including line_cogs/unit_cost_snapshot. Confirm intended visibility — the spec only mandates hiding cost_price from public catalog, so this is OK per spec but worth confirming with product.

AdminProducts NEW modal has no product-images-section because the product must exist first (images endpoints need product_id). This is expected but the flow could be improved by allowing image staging on create.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (dashboard, categorias, produtos w/ cost+margin, images add/upload/primary/delete, storefront regression)

rca of the issue: Only issue found: 500 on POST /api/orders when a percent-coupon (BRASIL10/MINIS20) was applied. Root cause: recent CMV migration converted product.price/cost/order fields to Decimal AND the subtotal path in order_service uses `float(subtotal)` when calling resolve_coupon; but coupon.value stayed as Decimal (Numeric column) and the multiplication `subtotal_float * coupon.value_decimal` raised TypeError at coupon_service.py line 21. Mitigation applied: cast `float(coupon.value)` before the multiplication. Verified fix by re-running the regression test test_order_with_coupon_and_shipping → PASS after backend restart.
